airGap_mm.note: 0.6 mm = replace. Air gap 0.5–0.6 mm: may continue in service until next scheduled maintenance.

brakes.stoppingCriterion: Replace if air gap > 0.6 mm. Continue in service if air gap ≤ 0.5 mm until next scheduled maintenance.
brakes.wearCheckMethod: Feeler gauge through brake plug hole — no disassembly required (units from 04/2009)
notes: Brake is BEFORE the slip clutch in the load path — if clutch slips, brake still holds load
Annual maintenance: re-grease V sealing ring with anti-friction bearing grease; no solid lubricant

Annual maintenance: re-grease V sealing ring with anti-friction bearing grease; no solid lubricant
Factory set to rated load capacity — do NOT adjust under normal conditions
Increase of trip torque beyond factory setting is NOT permitted
Annual function test: run chain limit stop above hook, run at creep — display should show SLIP LIFTING warning, motor fan turns
Mandatory annual check for models ≥ 1000 kg capacity (DC-Pro/Com 10 and DC-Pro 15)
Adjustment by authorised specialists only — use friction force checking device 836 708 44
